events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Marking the anniversary of the tragic passing of influential rapper Tupac Shakur in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty years on, Tupac Shakur's music and impact continue to resonate. We're looking back at the artist whose voice defined a generation.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix: Guitar Legend
events.blurb: Commemorating the anniversary of the death of rock icon Jimi Hendrix in London in 1970.

angles.name: Guitar God Tribute
angles.copy: A true pioneer, Jimi Hendrix redefined what was possible with a guitar. We remember the maestro who left us far too soon.

events.title: Abbey Road Turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic 'Abbey Road' album was released on this day in the UK in 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us the masterpiece that is 'Abbey Road'. Which track is your all-time favourite?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Happy 75th birthday to Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, born on this day in 1951.

angles.name: Pretenders Frontwoman
angles.copy: Celebrating Chrissie Hynde turning 75! The voice of The Pretenders, still rocking after all these years. What's your top track from her?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Wishing a happy 54th birthday to Oasis and Beady Eye frontman, Liam Gallagher, born on this day in 1972.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star Birthday
angles.copy: Our kid Liam Gallagher is 54 today! The iconic voice and swagger that defined a generation. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: Imagine Single Turns 55
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the US on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon released 'Imagine'. Its message of peace and unity is as powerful today as it was then.

events.title: The Original iPod Turns 25
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the first-generation iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: Music in Your Pocket
angles.copy: Remember the original iPod? Twenty-five years ago today, Apple changed how we listened to music forever. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day celebrates the premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in London in 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: It's Global James Bond Day! Raise a martini (shaken, not stirred) to 007. Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the best theme song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're celebrating the life and music of John Lennon. His legacy of peace and iconic songs live on.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Happy 87th birthday to the legendary British comedian and actor, John Cleese, born on this day in 1939.

angles.name: Comedy Legend Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true master of comedy.

events.title: The White Album Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, famously known as 'The White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: Experimental Beatles
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years of The White Album! The Beatles' sprawling, experimental double LP. What are your hidden gems from this iconic record?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Marking the anniversary of the death of Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury, in 1991.

angles.name: Legendary Performer Tribute
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song?

events.title: Rubber Soul Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in the UK in 1965.

angles.name: Folk-Rock Evolution
angles.copy: Sixty-one years of 'Rubber Soul'! The album that saw The Beatles push their sound into new, innovative territory. A true classic.
